summary: Risk-on with chips leading after CoreWeave's beat: midday reports put the Nasdaq 100 ~+2.8%, S&P ~+1.4%, Dow flat, SMH +6%; Dec hike odds high after hot CPI. Update: QQQ appears to have cleared 686 (levels raised), AMD put trimmed as the semis rally broadened; live quotes still blocked so prices are estimates.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq 100 widened to ~+2.8% midday on the AI/chip rebound, clearing 686; over 695 extends toward 700, back under 686 the breakout fails (price estimated from index move).

picks.name: CoreWeave
picks.reason: Up ~25% (~60.9) on the Q3 beat and raised guide, pressing the ~61 high; over 61 the run resumes, under 55.5 (opening price) the gap fades - extended.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Rebounding ~4-5% after the CEO-probe selloff, pressing the 177 premarket high; over 177 relief runs toward 180, under 171.5 the gap fills.

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Lagging after Tuesday's 2.2% drop on Anthropic Office-style tools while money rotates to chips; under 527 (Tuesday low) selling resumes, over 541 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Gap faded from ~546 premarket to ~533, but semis broadened (SMH +6%, MU +13%) so the fade is at risk; under 526 extends toward 515, over 541 the put is wrong.

picks.name: GE Vernova
picks.reason: Reports conflict (premarket giveback vs. +3% with AI-power names); under 765 extends the giveback, over 790 the put is wrong - low conviction.
